import {
  Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, IcosahedronGeometry, CircleGeometry,
  InstancedMesh, Object3D, Color, DirectionalLight, PointLight, AmbientLight,
  AdditiveBlending, InstancedBufferAttribute,
  MeshBasicNodeMaterial, MeshStandardNodeMaterial
} from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, vec4, mix, smoothstep, float, instanceIndex, attribute, positionView } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

const COLORS = {
  background: '#0b0b10',
  surface: '#101017',
  ink: '#16161d',
  paper: '#e8ecf2',
  accent: '#ff2a38'
};

function mulberry32(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0;
  return function () {
    a |= 0; a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

// -- stageBackdrop: gradient plane, DL16 no-void stage --------------------
function stageBackdrop(config) {
  const stops = config.intent?.visualSpec?.colors?.gradientStops ?? [
    { at: 0, hex: COLORS.background }, { at: 1, hex: COLORS.ink }
  ];
  const geo = new PlaneGeometry(7, 6);
  const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  const c0 = new Color(stops[0].hex);
  const c1 = new Color(stops[stops.length - 1].hex);
  const surface = new Color(COLORS.surface);
  const g = uv().y;
  // vertical gradient background->ink with a faint surface-tone band so the stage is graded, never flat
  const base = mix(vec3(c0.r, c0.g, c0.b), vec3(c1.r, c1.g, c1.b), g);
  const band = smoothstep(float(0.25), float(0.55), g).mul(smoothstep(float(0.85), float(0.55), g));
  mat.colorNode = mix(base, vec3(surface.r, surface.g, surface.b), band.mul(0.6));
  const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.position.set(0, 0, -2.5);
  return { mesh, geo, mat };
}

  rim.target.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);

    // ellipsoidal shell 6 x 4 x 5
    let x, y, z, d;
    do {

    const shell = 0.45 + 0.55 * Math.cbrt(rand()); // bias toward shell

  matField.emissiveNode = vec3(paper.r, paper.g, paper.b).mul(0.9);
  // depth falloff opacity + linear fog #0b0b10 near 4 far 10 (view-space) via TSL
  const alphaA = attribute('instAlpha', 'float');
  const fogT = smoothstep(float(4.0), float(10.0), positionView.z.negate());
  matField.opacityNode = alphaA.mul(fogT.oneMinus());
  matField.colorNode = mix(vec3(paper.r, paper.g, paper.b), vec3(bg.r, bg.g, bg.b), fogT);

  const field = new InstancedMesh(geoField, matField, FIELD_COUNT);

  const accent = new Color(COLORS.accent);
  const matCore = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    color: COLORS.accent, roughness: 0.6, metalness: 0,
    transparent: true, blending: AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false
  });
  const emissiveScale = { value: 1.8 }; // pulsed 1.5-1.8 via ticker
  const coreAnchors = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < CORE_COUNT; i++) {
    let x, y, z, d;
    do { x = rand() * 2 - 1; y = rand() * 2 - 1; z = rand() * 2 - 1; d = x * x + y * y + z * z; } while (d > 1);
    coreAnchors.push({ x: x * 0.5, y: y * 0.5, z: z * 0.5, phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2, s: 0 });
  }
  matCore.emissive = new Color(COLORS.accent);
  matCore.emissiveIntensity = 1.8;
  const core = new InstancedMesh(geoCore, matCore, CORE_COUNT);

  group.add(field, core);
  return { field, core, geoField, geoCore, matField, matCore, anchors, coreAnchors, accent, emissiveScale };
}

// -- typeBlock: MSDF hero / subhead / caption ------------------------------
function typeBlock(config, ctx, group) {
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const byRole = (role) => items.find((i) => i.role === role);
  const made = [];

  const hero = byRole('hero');
  if (hero) {
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(hero.text, {
      fontSize: hero.typography?.fontSize ?? 124,
      color: COLORS.paper, align: 'center', letterSpacingPx: -1
    });
    t.position.set(0, 0.5, 0.5);
    group.add(t); made.push(t);
  }
  const subhead = byRole('subhead');
  if (subhead) {
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(subhead.text, {
      fontSize: subhead.typography?.fontSize ?? 40,
      color: COLORS.paper, align: 'center'
    });
    t.position.set(0, -0.25, 0.5); // 0.75 below hero baseline
    group.add(t); made.push(t);
  }
  const caption = byRole('caption');
  if (caption) {
    const t = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(caption.text, {
      fontSize: caption.typography?.fontSize ?? 18,
      color: COLORS.paper, align: 'center', letterSpacingPx: 1.5
    });
    t.position.set(0, -2.25, 0.5);
    group.add(t); made.push(t);
  }
  return made;
}

// -- contactShadow: grounded radial disc + red floor glow ------------------
function contactShadow(group) {
  const geo = new CircleGeometry(1.6, 48);
  const mat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ transparent: true, depthWrite: false });
  const ink = new Color(COLORS.ink);
  const acc = new Color(COLORS.accent);
  const d = uv().sub(vec4(0.5, 0.5, 0, 0).xy).length().mul(2);
  const fall = smoothstep(float(1.0), float(0.0), d);
  mat.colorNode = mix(vec3(ink.r, ink.g, ink.b), vec3(acc.r, acc.g, acc.b), fall.mul(0.35));
  mat.opacityNode = fall.mul(0.5);
  const mesh = new Mesh(geo, mat);
  mesh.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  mesh.position.set(0, -2.6, -1.5);
  group.add(mesh);
  return { mesh, geo, mat };
}

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const group = new Group();
  group.name = 'particle-constellation-hero';

  const backdrop = stageBackdrop(config);
  group.add(backdrop.mesh);

  const lights = lightRig(group);
  const P = buildParticles(group);
  const texts = typeBlock(config, ctx, group);
  const shadow = contactShadow(group);

  // -- emergeAnimation + ambient drift ------------------------------------
  const dummy = new Object3D();
  const CENTER = { x: 0, y: 0, z: -1.5 };
  const emerge = { t: 0 };
  const clock = { t: 0 };

  function writeInstances() {
    const e = emerge.t;
    // field: stagger by distance-from-core
    for (let i = 0; i < P.anchors.length; i++) {
      const a = P.anchors[i];
      const dx = a.x - CENTER.x, dy = a.y - CENTER.y, dz = a.z - CENTER.z;
      const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
      const delay = (dist / 3.5) * 0.45;
      let lt = Math.min(Math.max((e - delay) / (1 - 0.45), 0), 1);
      lt = 1 - Math.pow(1 - lt, 3); // ease-out cubic ~ (0.165,0.84,0.44,1)
      const drift = 0.04;
      const w = 2 * Math.PI * 0.05; // 0.05 Hz
      const ox = Math.sin(clock.t * w + a.phase) * drift;
      const oy = Math.cos(clock.t * w * 0.9 + a.phase * 1.3) * drift;
      const oz = Math.sin(clock.t * w * 1.1 + a.phase * 0.7) * drift;
      dummy.position.set(
        CENTER.x + dx * lt + ox * lt,
        CENTER.y + dy * lt + oy * lt,
        CENTER.z + dz * lt + oz * lt
      );
      dummy.scale.setScalar(Math.max(lt, 0.0001));
      dummy.updateMatrix();
      P.field.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
    }
    P.field.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    for (let i = 0; i < P.coreAnchors.length; i++) {
      const a = P.coreAnchors[i];
      const lt = 1 - Math.pow(1 - Math.min(e * 1.6, 1), 3);
      const w = 2 * Math.PI * 0.05;
      dummy.position.set(
        a.x * lt + Math.sin(clock.t * w + a.phase) * 0.02,
        a.y * lt + Math.cos(clock.t * w + a.phase) * 0.02,
        a.z * lt
      );
      dummy.scale.setScalar(Math.max(lt, 0.0001));
      dummy.updateMatrix();
      P.core.setMatrixAt(i, dummy.matrix);
    }
    P.core.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
    // core pulse: emissive 1.5 -> 1.8 sine at 0.1 Hz
    P.matCore.emissiveIntensity = 1.65 + 0.15 * Math.sin(clock.t * 2 * Math.PI * 0.1);
  }

  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.to(emerge, { t: 1, duration: 1.4, ease: 'power3.out', onUpdate: writeInstances });
  // rise-in + weighted-settle on type
  texts.forEach((t, i) => {
    const y0 = t.position.y;
    tl.fromTo(t.position, { y: y0 - 0.3 }, { y: y0, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3.out' }, 0.2 + i * 0.08);
    tl.fromTo(t.scale, { x: 1.04, y: 1.04, z: 1.04 }, { x: 1, y: 1, z: 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power4.out' }, 0.5 + i * 0.08);
  });

  const tick = () => { clock.t += gsap.ticker.deltaRatio(60) / 60; writeInstances(); };
  gsap.ticker.add(tick);
  writeInstances();

  // -- primitives: apply every configured cinematic primitive -------------
  const primHandles = [];
  for (const p of (config.cinematicPrimitives ?? [])) {
    const fn = ctx.primitives?.[p.name];
    if (fn) primHandles.push(fn(P.field, p.params ?? {}));
  }

  group.userData.handlers = {};
  group.userData.cleanup = () => {
    tl.kill();
    gsap.ticker.remove(tick);
    primHandles.forEach((h) => h?.cleanup?.());
    [backdrop.geo, shadow.geo, P.geoField, P.geoCore].forEach((g) => g.dispose());
    [backdrop.mat, shadow.mat, P.matField, P.matCore].forEach((m) => m.dispose());
    P.field.dispose();
    P.core.dispose();
    texts.forEach((t) => {
      t.traverse((o) => { o.geometry?.dispose?.(); o.material?.dispose?.(); });
    });
  };

  return group;
}
